scope: Binance Spot OCO native order-list cancellation adapter request and response path

assertions: Venue::cancel sends DELETE to /api/v3/orderList using the persisted orderListId, deterministic listClientOrderId, and symbol
the adapter validates OCO list identity, ALL_DONE states, and both child reports before emitting the target child cancellation fact
the aggregate covers 373 named checks without duplicates

limitations: The endpoint response is supplied by a local HTTP transport stub; no Binance API or Testnet request was made.
This verifies the adapter transport boundary and response reducer, not exchange permissions, live cancellation races, or restart recovery on Binance.
